name: hashI2
role: deterministic 0..1 lattice hash; the atom every 2D noise is built on (bit-identical to hybrid_world/field_particle CPU mirror)

name: hashU
role: PCG-style integer hash for per-index random streams (particle scatter, stamp jitter, seed derivation)

name: hash3
wgsl: fn hash3(p:vec3f)->f32 { var q=fract(p*0.3183099+vec3f(0.1,0.2,0.3)); q*=17.0; return fract(q.x*q.y*q.z*(q.x+q.y+q.z)); }
role: 3D lattice hash (hybrid_world's h3); cheaper/dependency-free feeder for 3D value noise

name: valueNoise2
role: smooth 0..1 base field; the canonical 2D primitive reused verbatim across all three labs

name: valueNoise3
role: volumetric base field for clouds/biome/density; quintic-fade version from hybrid_world's cloud volume

name: perlin2
role: gradient noise (signed, zero mean before bias) - smoother lobes than value noise, better for warp fields

name: simplex2
role: gradient noise on a simplex lattice - no axis-aligned artifacts, isotropic; best for flow-like organic fields

name: worley2
role: cellular/Voronoi distance (F1,F2). F1=cell fill, F2-F1=crack/edge network -> rock cracks, scales, veins, cracked coastlines

name: worley3
role: volumetric cellular - foam/bubble structure in clouds, crystal packing in geology, cell membranes in creatures

name: fbm2
role: multi-octave sum -> continents/hills/base relief. The workhorse; identical recurrence (s+o*101, amp*0.5, fr*2) to existing labs

name: fbm3
wgsl: fn fbm3(p:vec3f, oct:i32)->f32 { var s=0.0; var a=0.6; var f=1.0; var nm=0.0; for(var o=0;o<oct;o++){ s+=a*vn3(p*f); nm+=a; f*=2.0; a*=0.5; } return s/nm; }
role: volumetric fBm -> cloud density, 3D biome selection, nebula/gas - matches hybrid_world cloud fbm3

name: ridged2
role: sharp mountain crests / eroded ridgelines; the invert-abs-square-feedback trick, verbatim from both terrain labs

name: billow2
role: puffy rounded lobes (abs of signed noise, no inversion) -> boulders, cumulus bases, cellular dunes; ridged's complement

name: turbulence2
role: |noise| fBm - marble/flame veining, wispy atmosphere filaments; feeds domain-warp offsets

name: domainWarp
role: offset sample position by a noise field -> the single most important coherence op; turns blobs into flows, ridges, swirls (Perlin's warp)

name: domainWarp3
role: volumetric warp -> swirling gas, twisted cave walls, marbled creature flesh, cloud advection distortion

name: warpRecursive
role: fBm(p + fBm(p + fBm(p))) - two-level recursive warp -> the classic 'fluid/organic mystery' look, structured coherence for free

name: scale
wgsl: fn opScale(p:vec3f, k:f32)->vec3f { return p*k; }
role: uniform frequency change - the exponent knob a meta-generator turns to pick feature size

name: rotate2
wgsl: fn rotate2(p:vec2f, a:f32)->vec2f { let c=cos(a); let s=sin(a); return vec2f(c*p.x-s*p.y, s*p.x+c*p.y); }
role: orient anisotropy - directional dunes, strata dip, wind-aligned clouds; also decorrelates octaves when applied per-octave

name: tile
wgsl: fn opTile(p:vec2f, period:f32)->vec2f { return (fract(p/period+0.5)-0.5)*period; }
role: wrap space into a repeating cell -> seamless textures, periodic worlds, infinite tiling from a finite recipe

name: mirror
wgsl: fn opMirror(p:vec2f)->vec2f { return abs(p); }
role: reflect across axes -> bilateral symmetry (creature bodies, leaves, crystal twins)

name: radialSymmetry
role: N-fold rotational fold -> flowers, snowflakes, radiolaria, mandala biomes; a meta-gen dial (n=5 flower, n=6 snow)

name: kaleidoscope
role: folded wedge + radius-dependent twist -> exotic ornamental phenomena, spiral galaxies, shell whorls

name: add
wgsl: fn opAdd(a:f32,b:f32)->f32 { return a+b; }
role: superpose two fields - continent + detail layering (the fundamental fBm assembly step)

name: mul
wgsl: fn opMul(a:f32,b:f32)->f32 { return a*b; }
role: gate one field by another -> mountains only where a mask is high (the mount*m pattern in existing heightAt)

name: sub
wgsl: fn opSub(a:f32,b:f32)->f32 { return a-b; }
role: carve one field from another - rivers cut into terrain, erosion channels, cloud holes

name: mix
wgsl: fn opMix(a:f32,b:f32,t:f32)->f32 { return mix(a,b,clamp(t,0.0,1.0)); }
role: blend two generators by a third field -> biome transitions, the core of every 'mix(sand,grass,...)' in the labs

name: min
wgsl: fn opMin(a:f32,b:f32)->f32 { return min(a,b); }
role: union of valleys / intersection of solids; SDF-boolean glue and 'lowest wins' terrain floors (lakes)

name: max
wgsl: fn opMax(a:f32,b:f32)->f32 { return max(a,b); }
role: highest-wins overlay -> plateau clamping, mesa tops, keeping the tallest of competing mountain systems

name: powShape
wgsl: fn opPow(a:f32,k:f32)->f32 { return pow(clamp(a,0.0,1.0),k); }
role: reshape contrast/valley-floor flatness; k>1 flattens lows & sharpens peaks, k<1 plateaus - controls terrain 'character'

name: smoothMin
wgsl: fn smin(a:f32,b:f32,k:f32)->f32 { let h=clamp(0.5+0.5*(b-a)/k,0.0,1.0); return mix(b,a,h)-k*h*(1.0-h); }
role: blended union - organic merges between blobs (creature limbs, fused rock, metaball terrain) with no hard seam

name: threshold
wgsl: fn opStep(x:f32,e:f32)->f32 { return step(e,x); }
role: hard cut -> coastlines (land/sea), binary spawn masks, cell walls; the sharpest interpretation of a scalar field

name: smoothBand
wgsl: fn opSmooth(x:f32,e0:f32,e1:f32)->f32 { return smoothstep(e0,e1,x); }
role: soft mask 0..1 - the mountain mask m=smoothstep(0.45,0.72,mtn0), beach fade, snow line; the universal soft selector

name: contourBands
wgsl: fn opBands(x:f32,n:f32)->f32 { let g=x*n; return (floor(g)+smoothstep(0.4,0.6,fract(g)))/n; }
role: quantize into stepped terraces -> rice-paddy terrain, sedimentary strata, topographic contour rings, cel shading

name: isoLine
wgsl: fn opIso(x:f32,level:f32,w:f32)->f32 { let d=abs(x-level); return 1.0-smoothstep(0.0,w,d); }
role: bright ridge at a single value -> shorelines, contour lines, cell membranes, river-at-sealevel highlighting

name: gradient2
role: central-difference slope of a field -> surface normals, steepness masks (cliffs=rock), the basis of flow/erosion

name: normalFromHeight
role: world-space normal from any height generator - lifted verbatim from both terrain labs' vertex shaders; feeds lighting

name: curl2
role: divergence-free flow field (perp of gradient) -> swirling wind, hair/fur direction, particle advection that never sinks/sources

name: downhill
role: steepest-descent direction on terrain -> river routing, debris rolling, lava flow, water accumulation seeds

name: sdSphere
wgsl: fn sdSphere(p:vec3f, r:f32)->f32 { return length(p)-r; }
role: signed-distance ball - the base primitive for metaball creatures, boulders, planetoids, cloud cores

name: sdBox
wgsl: fn sdBox(p:vec3f, b:vec3f)->f32 { let q=abs(p)-b; return length(max(q,vec3f(0.0)))+min(max(q.x,max(q.y,q.z)),0.0); }
role: signed box - crystals, architecture, blocky geology, cave chambers when subtracted

name: sdTorus
wgsl: fn sdTorus(p:vec3f, t:vec2f)->f32 { let q=vec2f(length(p.xz)-t.x, p.y); return length(q)-t.y; }
role: ring primitive - arches, orbital structures, exotic-phenomenon rings, creature mouth/eye sockets

name: sdCapsule
wgsl: fn sdCapsule(p:vec3f, a:vec3f, b:vec3f, r:f32)->f32 { let pa=p-a; let ba=b-a; let h=clamp(dot(pa,ba)/dot(ba,ba),0.0,1.0); return length(pa-ba*h)-r; }
role: segment-with-radius - creature limbs, tree trunks, tentacles; smin-unioned into skeletons

name: sdOpUnion
role: CSG booleans (union/subtract/intersect) on SDFs -> caves carved from rock, compound creatures, arch-through-mountain

name: sdSmoothUnion
wgsl: fn opSU(a:f32,b:f32,k:f32)->f32 { let h=clamp(0.5+0.5*(b-a)/k,0.0,1.0); return mix(b,a,h)-k*h*(1.0-h); }
role: blended CSG union -> organic metaball bodies where limbs fuse smoothly into a torso; the creature-builder's core

name: sdfDisplace
wgsl: fn sdfDisplace(d:f32, p:vec3f, amp:f32)->f32 { return d + (fbm3(p,4)-0.5)*2.0*amp; }
role: add fBm to a smooth SDF surface -> bumpy asteroids, warty skin, eroded crystal, lumpy clouds from a clean primitive

name: reactionDiffusion
role: ITERATED: grows spots/stripes/mazes/coral from noise seed -> animal coats, coral, lichen, alien skin. NEEDS ping-pong state texture + many passes (cannot be a pure p->f32 sample)

name: cellularAutomata
role: ITERATED: smooths noise into connected cave systems / dungeon rooms / island archipelagos. NEEDS neighbour-reading ping-pong grid, several passes

name: hydraulicErosion
role: ITERATED: cuts realistic V-valleys, gullies, alluvial fans, sediment deltas into a raw fBm terrain. NEEDS height+sediment ping-pong grids over many steps

name: flowAccumulation
role: ITERATED: derives drainage networks / river width from terrain -> where rivers carve & where lakes pool. NEEDS multi-pass scatter to downhill neighbour

name: particleDeposit
role: ITERATED: the field<->particle join already in labs. Erosion/dunes/piles as conserved mass transfer + heal-to-seed. NEEDS atomic depo grid + resolve pass

name: scatterMask
role: blue-noise-ish point placement -> tree/rock/creature spawn points, star fields, crater centers; density is the meta-gen dial

name: stamp
role: instance a primitive per grid cell with per-cell jitter+rotation+scale -> scattered boulders, craters, buildings, scales, leaves

name: maskCombine
wgsl: fn maskCombine(base:f32, mask:f32, stampVal:f32)->f32 { return mix(base, stampVal, clamp(mask,0.0,1.0)); }
role: apply a stamp only where a mask permits -> craters only on plains, trees only below snowline (biome-gated scatter)

name: remapCurve
wgsl: fn remap(x:f32,e0:f32,e1:f32,o0:f32,o1:f32)->f32 { return o0+(clamp(x,e0,e1)-e0)*(o1-o0)/(e1-e0); }
role: linear range remap - the universal adaptor between operators; normalizes any field into the range the next op expects

name: terrace
wgsl: fn terrace(x:f32, steps:f32, sharp:f32)->f32 { let s=x*steps; let f=fract(s); let k=floor(s); return (k+pow(f,sharp))/steps; }
role: nonlinear stepping with adjustable riser sharpness -> geological strata, paddy fields, mesa layers (finer control than contourBands)

name: gain
wgsl: fn gain(x:f32,k:f32)->f32 { let a=0.5*pow(2.0*select(x,1.0-x,x>=0.5),k); return select(a,1.0-a,x>=0.5); }
role: S-curve / contrast around 0.5 -> punchy vs washed-out fields; a single tunable character knob for any 0..1 generator

name: palette
wgsl: fn palette(t:f32, a:vec3f, b:vec3f, c:vec3f, d:vec3f)->vec3f { return a + b*cos(6.2831853*(c*t+d)); }
role: IQ cosine palette: 4 vec3 constants -> an infinite family of coherent color ramps. The meta-gen INVENTS biome palettes by choosing a,b,c,d from seed

name: colorRamp
role: height+slope -> terrain color; the exact ramp from both terrain labs, parameterized so meta-gen can swap the stops/palette

name: timeAdvance
wgsl: fn timeAdvance(p:vec3f, t:f32, vel:vec3f)->vec3f { return p + vel*t; }
role: translate sample space by t*wind -> the '+time = weather' thesis: same field, scrolled -> moving clouds/water (u.camPos.w carries t)

name: pulse
wgsl: fn pulse(t:f32, freq:f32)->f32 { return sin(t*freq)*0.5+0.5; }
role: periodic 0..1 driver -> pulsing bioluminescence, tides, day/night, breathing creatures; animates any static generator

name: flowNoise
role: advect a noise field along its own curl over time -> living, roiling surfaces (lava, plasma, storm cells) that stay coherent

name: asHeight
wgsl: fn asHeight(x:f32, amp:f32, base:f32)->f32 { return base + (x-0.5)*2.0*amp; }
role: INTERPRET scalar as vertical displacement -> terrain surface. The (cont-0.45)*420 pattern generalized

name: asDensity
wgsl: fn asDensity(x:f32, coverage:f32, hGrad:f32)->f32 { let c=smoothstep(0.0,1.0,clamp((x-(1.0-coverage))/0.42,0.0,1.0)); return max(c*hGrad,0.0); }
role: INTERPRET scalar as volumetric opacity for raymarching -> clouds/gas/nebula. Exact cloud-coverage remap from hybrid_world

name: asColor
wgsl: fn asColor(x:f32, grad:vec2f)->vec3f { return palette(x, vec3f(0.5), vec3f(0.5), vec3f(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3f(0.0,0.33,0.67)); }
role: INTERPRET scalar(+gradient) as albedo -> biome/creature/mineral color via palette; gradient can drive slope-shading

name: asFlow
wgsl: fn asFlow(p:vec2f)->vec2f { return normalize(curl2(p,0.01)+1e-6); }
role: INTERPRET field as a 2D direction map -> wind, current, fur/hair grain, particle advection velocity

name: asVelocity
wgsl: fn asVelocity(p:vec3f, t:f32)->vec3f { let f=curl2(p.xz*0.3, 0.02); return vec3f(f.x, (fbm3(p+vec3f(0.0,t,0.0),3)-0.5), f.y)*2.0; }
role: INTERPRET field as a 3D velocity for particles (the PART) -> swarms, dust, sparks that follow the field's curl coherently

name: asSpawnMask
wgsl: fn asSpawnMask(x:f32, thresh:f32)->f32 { return step(thresh,x); }
role: INTERPRET field as a binary placement mask -> where creatures/props/particles are born; couples generator to the scatter pool

name: asEmissive
wgsl: fn asEmissive(x:f32, col:vec3f, t:f32)->vec3f { return col*pow(clamp(x,0.0,1.0),3.0)*(0.6+0.4*pulse(t,2.0)); }
role: INTERPRET field as self-illumination -> lava cracks, bioluminescent veins, magic runes, star cores; feeds HDR bloom in the labs' rgba16f pipeline

name: asNormal
wgsl: fn asNormal(grad:vec2f, strength:f32)->vec3f { return normalize(vec3f(-grad.x*strength, 1.0, -grad.y*strength)); }
role: INTERPRET a field's gradient as a surface normal for lighting -> detail bumps without geometry (bark, scales, ripples)
